name: seo-module-tests
description: Build-output assertion suite for the seo Hugo module, run against the static HTML that thirteen hugo builds of ./fixture produce -- the baseline, configured, subpath, subpath with canonifyURLs, badtypes, offswitch, multilingual, pagination, pagination under a subpath baseURL, graph, sitename, generated and hometitle environments. The module ships zero JavaScript, so there is no browser behavior to test.
